Mission 01: Catering the Lions Den
states: You must bring Zalamon 3 nails and a piece of wood so that he can make a Marked Crate for you.

Go to the tunnel in eastern Muggy Plains and reach the other side. Try to hide in the dark and avoid being seen at all by using the crate. After that you need to find the rebel hideout and talk to their leader Chartan.
You passed the maintenance tunnel and successfully made contact with the resistance in their hideout north of the Great Gate.

missions.name: Mission 02: First Contact
states: Chartan needs you to reactivate the teleport to the Muggy Plains. Head downstairs and into the temple and craft material to repair the teleport. To do this you will need some tools to improvise.
As you give the coal into the pool the corrupted fluid begins to dissolve, leaving purified, refreshing water. The teleporter is reactivated. Report back to Chartan.
Report back to Zalamon for the next mission.

missions.name: Mission 03: The Keeper
states: Zalamon gives you a Flask of Plant Poison to destroy plants in the garden of the Emperor to lure out and kill The Keeper to get his tail. The garden is southeast of the rebel hideout.
You killed the Keeper and got his tail. Bring it to Zalamon.
You brought the tail of the Keeper to Zalamon and completed the mission. Ask for the next mission.

missions.name: Mission 04: Sacrament of the Snake
states: Zalamon now wants you to go to Deeper Banuta and get an Ancient Sceptre that will help in the fight against the emperor. On each floor under Deeper Banuta you collect a sceptre part from a Ghost of a Priest. On the 4th and final floor you need to assemble the sceptre..
After you've assembled the Snake Sceptre and fought your way back out, head back to Zalamon and give it to him.
You have delievered the recreated sceptre to the rebels.

missions.name: Mission 05: New in Town
states: Enter the imperial city Razachai to the west and talk to your contact in the ministry there for further missions.
Now you only have to walk west until you find Zlak inside the big green building.
You went deep inside the city to find Zlak and completed the mission. Ask for the next mission.

strings: Kill four Magistrati in the office building. Then report back to Zlak. You have killed %d magistrati so far.
Kill six nobles in the city and report back to Zlak. You have killed %d nobles so far.

missions.name: Mission 08: Uninvited Guests
states: Use the old escape tunnel in the northern basement of the ministry to enter the imperial palace. Fight your way to the basement to meet your new rebel contact.
You have reached your rebel contact Zizzle in the imperial palace.

missions.name: Mission 09: The Sleeping Dragon
states: To enter the inner realms of the Emperor you need to free the mind of a dragon. An interdimensional potion will help you to enter this dream and unleash his consciousness.
You travelled through the Sleeping Dragon dreams and freed his mind.

missions.name: Mission 10: A Message of Freedom
states: After solving the riddle, and talking again to the Sleeping Dragon you got a Spiritual Charm. Report back to Zizzle.

You possess the key to enter the inner realms of the emperor. Start with the one in the north-west and work your way clockwise trough the room and kill those manifestation. Then use your sceptre on the remain to destroy the emperor's influence over the crystal.
You possess the key to enter the inner realms of the emperor. You destroyed 1 of 4 emperor's influences.
You possess the key to enter the inner realms of the emperor. You destroyed 2 of 4 emperor's influences.
You possess the key to enter the inner realms of the emperor. You destroyed 3 of 4 emperor's influences.
You possess the key to enter the inner realms of the emperor. You destroyed all emperor's influences.

missions.name: Mission 11: Payback Time
states: Your Mission is to kill Zalamon. Step into the teleporter to confront him. Finally use your sceptre on the death body.
Go back to Awareness Of The Emperor and report him your success!

states.0: The Emperor has promised you wealth beyond measure. Go claim it in the ministry.
states.1: You completed this Quest!

missions.name: To Take Roots
missions.description: Five Juicy roots from the outskirts of Rathleton may already help feed the poor. Try to find a city official to deliver them to or go to the Rathleton poor house.

missions.name: Circle of the Black Sphinx
states: You defeated the rogue Lady Tenebris.

missions.name: Bane of the Cosmic Force
states: You calmed poor, misguided Lloyd. All he wanted was protection from the outside world. Luckily he seems to have learned his lesson... or has he?

missions.name: The Desecrated Glade
states: You defeated the Thorn Knight and shattered the root of evil with all your might. The honor of being a guardian of the glade indeed comes with pride as well as responsibility.

missions.name: The Unwary Mage
states: With help of Ivalisse from the temple of the Astral Shapers in Thais and her father, you averted the Dragon King's menace deep in the Zao Muggy Plains.

missions.name: Dragon in Distress
states: You saved the Dragon Mother's egg and she melted the ice wall that blocked your way.

missions.name: Time is a Window
states: You defeated the Time Guardian and are free to return to your own time. For some creatures in this world, it seems neither past nor future are an obstacle.

missions.name: Final Fight
states: Description Fault.

strings: You already hunted %d/200 dragons.

missions.name: Treasure
missions.description: Treasure is the favorite of the dragon lords. Find and take Kalyassa's treasures spread across the world.

missions.name: Knowledge
missions.description: You learned that frost dragon's incitement is the thirst for knowledge, perhaps if you bring some to Gelidrazah's you'll meet him.

missions.name: Life
missions.description: Undead dragons aspires for life. No better way to see life as it grows around the world, is there?

strings:
James asked you to enter the cave for hunting 50 empowered minotaurs. Then he will be able to continue his research.
Minotaurs killed: %d/50

missions.name: The Strengthtening of the Minotaurs
states: Gerimor told you that the naturalist Jamesfrancis is an expert of minotaurs. Right now he is investigating a cave in minocity. But this time something seems to be completely different.
Jamesfrancis already entered the inner part of the cave weeks ago but had to flee when the minotaurs became too strong. He gave you the key to investigate this room as well.
You found an entrance to the minotaur boss. You killed it and now you have to return to Jamesfrancis.
Jamesfrancis sent you to talk with Gerimor about the minotaur cult.
You have reported the Druid of Crunor about the minotaur cult.

missions.name: Patron of Arts
states: The Druid of Cronor gave you the hint that the Thais exhibition has expanded. The new section is called MOTA (Museum of Tibian Arts). It's really worth a visit.
Gareth told you how to become a patron of the arts. To fulfil your duty you have to manage some tasks. First you have to investigate the crime scene of a theft in the museum.
You found a ransom note, wich requests you to pay some money for the stolen picture to a stonge in Kazordoon. His name is Iwar. Nevertheless I should talk to Gareth first.
You told Gareth about the ransom note. He asked you to pay the money to Iwar to get the picture back. In his opinion, there is no alternative.
You paid the money to stooge in Kazordoon. You were told that the picture is delivered to Gareth himself.
You have to go to Angelo and get a magnifier to investigate all small pictures in the entrance hall of the MOTA. One of them should be a fake.
Angelo allowed you to take a magnifier from a crate next to the cave entrance.
You've fetched the magnifier from Angelo's crate. You're ready for your job in the museum.
Indeed! One of the investigated small pictures is fake. Report to Gareth!
After you told Gareth about the fake painting, he asked you to go to Angelo to get a new picture.
Angelo was not willing to give you a new picture. However, they havent found any artefact in the sandy cave yet. Report to Gareth about your failure.
Even though you weren't successful in getting a replacement for the fake picture, Gareth gave you access to the last floor of the museum. This area is for patrons only.
INTERNAL MESSAGE: THIS NEED QUESTLOG INFORMATION
The Denomintator opened the door for you after you answered his questions to the wanted number. In the end he mentioned the Druid of Conor. Maybe you should pay him a visit.
In the end you told the Druid of Crunor about your experiences in the MoTA.

missions.name: Barkless
states: The members of the Barkless follow a rigid path of hardship and sacrifice. Their cult is located somewhere beneath Ab'dendriel. Whatever happened to their leader, only a true Barkless can find out.
You survived the sulphur and tar trial. You accepted the stigma of misfortune and vanity. The hardest part, however, is yet to come. Give your life to the ice... to become true and purified.

strings: You survived the Trial. Barkless now have the right to see the cult leader but a powerful relic is sealing the path. Barkless markings broken to reverse the power of the cult object: %d of 10

states: You broke enough Barkless markings to now reverse the seal held up by the cult object in the ritual chamber. The power you gained feels unnatural and excessive but it seems ther is no other way.
Something far more powerful than the beliel of your Barkless brothers and sisters powered the seal to the leader. Whatever the case - find Leiden, or as he's known to his devotees: the "Penitent".
The Leiden you confronted has strayed far from his own original vision of Barkless. What you encountered was more monster than elf and less virtuous than his devotees would have you believe.
You returned to Gerimor after putting an end to the mischief of Leyden the Penitent. May the Barkless walk the true path again one day.

missions.name: Misguided
states: ASD
Below a ruin in the vicinity of the outlaw camp east of Thais a strange figure in ragged clothes hinted at something weird going on in a cave. He seemed too confused to decide whether to stop you.

strings: While rubbish, the amulet you equipe emits a strange aura of splendour. You feel an urge to fulfill the amulets hunger for especific deaths... Exorcisms: %d/5

states: You defeated the cult leader of Misguided by uncovering the true master to pull his strings and freeing this world from its malicious existance. Return to Gerimor to tell him about the victory.
You have spoken to Gerimor about your victory.

missions.name: The Orc Idol
states: ASD
ASD
You returned to Gerimor after facing the being the orcs worshipped. Whatever it was, it did not find the orcs by accident. A far more powerful force seems to have strategically place it here.

missions.name: The Secret of the Sandy Cave
states: ASD
ASD
In the cave you haven't found one of the missing scientists. However, you have faced a lots of strange mummies and a green oasis at the end.
After you informed Angelo about your experiences in the cave, he asked you to go back to analyse the water of the oasis. For that reason you got an analysis tool.
You have analysed the water with the help of the analysis tool from Angelo.
You informed Angelo about the analyzed water. He gave you a counteragent, wich you have to apply to the oasis.
You applied the counteragent to the oasis, just like Angelo had asked you to. But the effect was different from what you had expected. A sandstorm approached and caused create damage to the oasis.
You Killed the boss
You reported your victory to Angelo
You have told Gerimor about your stay in the sandy cave. He was not really surprised and felt vindicated that the rumors about a cult in the cave might be true.

missions.name: Zathroth Remmants

strings:
A remnant cult of Zathroth has formed in a forbidden temple beneath Carlin. Find out what's behind this and stop it in time.
Temporarily vaporised souls:
%d Decaying
%d Withering

states: ASD
You returned to Gerimor after encounter with the remnants of Zathroth. On one hand its is furtunate that Zathroth indeed wasn't behind all this, but on the other... what is going on there?

missions.name: The Secret of the Sandy Cave
Dwarves: Home Improvement

strings:
Destroy makeshift homes of the Lost to force them to fight you! Try making some prisoners in the progress and report back to Klom Stonecutter.

Lost Exiles: %d/20
Prisoners (bonus): %d/3

states: You drove off the Lost but more are sure to come. Check back with Klom Stonecutter at a later time.

missions.name: Dwarves: Subterranean Life

strings:
Klome Stonecutter sent you on a grave mission to exterminate large populaces of subterranian life. Looks like the dwarves make short work of the deep intruders.

Subterranean organisms: %d/50

states: You helped Klom defend the outpost by cutting down a number of vermin from deep down below. The gnomes don't seem to completely approve of this but everyone appreciates the drop in the enemy's ranks.

missions.name: Gnomes: Gnomal Warming Measurements

strings:
Gnomus sent you on a mission to measure the rising heat from below.

Location A: %d/1
Location B: %d/1
Location C: %d/1
Location D: %d/1
Location E: %d/1

states: You helped Lardoc Bashsmite fighting back the verminous growth in the northern mineshaft. Return to him later to see if he has more work for you.

missions.name: Gnomes: Ordnance
states: Gnomus sent you to find and rescue the gnome ordnance the outpost is currently waiting for. Travel to the east of the cave system and find the old gnome trail where reinforcements will arrive.

strings:
You found the old gnome trail where ordnance for the gnome outpost arrive, escort them and their pack animals to safety and return to Gnomus.

Rescued gnomes: %d/5
Rescued animals: %d/3

states: You helped Lardoc Bashsmite fighting back the verminous growth in the northern mineshaft. Return to him later to see if he has more work for you.

missions.name: Gnomes: Uncharted Territory

strings:
Chart the area around the deep base for Gnomus. Look for especific landmarks: 

Old Gate: %d/1
The Gaze: %d/1
Lost Ruin: %d/1
Outpost: %d/1
Bastion: %d/1
Broken Tower: %d/1

states: You helped Gnomus chart the area around the deep base. You found traces of what could have been an old civilisation but there's not enough left to draw any conclusion.

missions.name: Scouts: Explosive Growth

strings:
You found the mine shaft. Burn all the growth and report back to Lardoc Bashsmite! 

First Room: %d/1

Fifth room: %d/1

states: You helped Lardoc Bashsmite fighting back the verminous growth in the northern mineshaft. Return to him later to see if he has more work for you.

missions.name: Scouts: Pesticide

strings:
Lardoc asked you to follow a plan of the gnomes to stop the deep threat by trying to neutralise diremaw spawn with pesticies. Diremaws lay eggs inside corpses of their skin. 

Neutralised: %d/20

states: You reported back to Lardoc Bashsmite to inform him that the gnome's plan to neutralise diremaw corpses seems to work.

strings: You are exploring the Kha'zeel Dragon Lairs. Others obviously found a terrible end here. But the dragon hoards might justify the risks. You killed %d/50 dragons and dragon lords.

missions.name: The Lost Brother
states: At the Kha'zeel Mountains you met the merchant Tarun. His brother has gone missing and was last seen following a beautiful woman into a palace. Tarun fears this woman might have been a demon.
You found the remains of Tarun's brother containing a message. Go back to Tarun and report his brother's last words.
You told Tarun about his brother's sad fate. He was very downhearted but gave you his sincere thanks. The beautiful asuri have taken a young man's life and the happiness of another one.

missions.name: In the Adventures Outpost
missions.description: You have reached the Outpost, where young heroes are trained in combat and hunting. When you have reached level 8 at least, you can leave for the Mainland. Talk to Inigo if you have questions.

missions.name: The Lost Amulet
states: Mr Morris tasked you to find an ancient amulet that was lost somewhere on Dawnport - probably next to a corpse somewhere.
Deliver the ancient amulet back to Mr Morris.
You returned the lost amulet to Mr Morris and received your reward.

missions.name: The Stolen Log Book
states: Mr Morris urged you to find a log book that was stolen by trolls.
You got the log book back from the troll caves and received a reward for your efforts.

missions.name: The Rare Herb
states: Mr Morris needs the rare Dawnfire herb harvested and brought to him. It grows on gray sand only, he said.
You harvested a sample of the rare Dawnfire herb. Bring the sample to Mr Morris.
You managed to find the rare Dawnfire herb and were rewarded by Mr Morris. Nice job!

missions.name: The Dorm Key
states: The key to the adventurer's dormitory has disappeared. Maybe you can find it. Ask around to find out who was the last to have seen it.
Use a fishing rod in the pond to catch Old Nasty, you also requiere worms to use as bait.
You did it! You caught Old Nasty, you should inform Woblin about your catch.
Woblin was pleased about your catch his arch enemy Old Nasty. He gave you the lost adventurer's dormitory key as reward, hurry and delivery the key back to Mr Morris.
You found the key to the adventurers' dormitory and received a little reward on top of the thanks of everyone.

strings: You already hunted %d/20 Mountain Trolls.
You already hunted %d/20 Muglex Clan Footman.
You already hunted %d/20 Minotaurs Bruisers.

missions.name: Mission 01: A Taste of Things to Come
Mission 02: Defence!
states: Vascalir promised you some equipment, but first you need to build up some muscles. Find a big pile of stone in a barn to the north and use it to get a heavy stone.
You retrieved one stone from the big pile. Climb onto the roof of either Norma's bar, Obi's shop or the academy to find a catapult to use it on.
You loaded a stone on one of the catapults. One more to go! Climb onto the roof of either Norma's bar, Obi's shop or the academy to find a catapult to load with a heavy stone.
Two of the four catapults on the roofs are loaded. That should be enough to build up a decent defence. Return to Vascalir to turn in your quest.
You made sure that Rookgaard's defences are at their best. If the orcs try to enter the village, they won't have an easy time!

strings: Vascalir sent you to the Rookgaard sewers to kill 5 rats. You have already killed %d/5. Return to Vascalir once you're done.

missions.name: Mission 04: Home-Brewed
states: Vascalir doesn't have a job for you at the moment. He sent you to Lily in the south-west of town for another mission.
Lily gave you a bag with fresh herbs that need to be delivered to Hyacinth outside of the village. Leave the village to the north and walk east to find his little hut up a mountain.
You've delivered the fresh herbs to Hyacinth. He still has a reward for you though - make sure to talk to him again!
Hyacinth has another reward for you - make sure to talk to him again with enough space in your inventory.
You've delivered the herbs to Hyacinth and got potions and a ring as reward. Save the potions for when you're low on health and wear the ring if you want to regain health faster. Return to Vascalir.
You've told Vascalir about your successful delivery. The next mission awaits.

missions.name: Mission 05: Web of Terror
states: Vascalir sent you to the spider queen's lair to retrieve a web sample. Leave the village to the north and cross the bridge to the north-west to find the lair. Look for greasy blue stones.
You've covered yourself in grease. It's a bit disgusting, but the spider queen will not be able to smell you for about two minutes. Enter her cave and USE an intact spider web to retrieve a sample.
You retrieved some of the spider queen's web. Return to Vascalir and try not to get caught by the queen on the way out!
The spider queen caught you in her net. If you had a sample of her web, you've lost it. Find a way out of her net and retry!
Vascalir took the sample from you. He still has a studded armor for you - talk to him once you have enough space in your inventory.
You've brought the spider queen's web back to Vascalir. This will definitely come in handy later on.

missions.name: Mission 06: Run Like a Wolf
states: Vascalir sent you to Tom the Tanner, who can be found to the west of the academy. There you will get your next mission.
Leave the village to the north and walk north-east into the forest to find the wolves' den that Tom told you about. Hopefully you will find that poacher to take some leather from him!
You've entered the wolves' den - that was a one-way fall, but luckily you didn't get hurt. The poacher you were looking for is dead - but that doesn't mean you can't get some war wolf leather!
You've skinned a war wolf - but you alerted the wolf pack! Run to the exit, quickly!
RUN! You have only a limited time to reach the exit with the war wolf leather!
Phew - you managed to get out of the wolves' den in time. Return to Tom to finish your mission.
Tom gave you a pair of leather boots as reward for your good work. Vascalir surely has a new mission for you now.

missions.name: Mission 07: Attack!
states: While you were gone, trolls have infiltrated the academy and set it on fire! Enter the burning vault deep underground and try to recover the copy of the book of orc language before it's destroyed.
You've done all you could - but unfortunately the book is lost. No need to lose heart though - there is still hidden knowledge about the orc language in the village, and the next mission awaits.

missions.name: Mission 08: Less Risk - More Fun
states: Before getting revenge on the trolls, eliminate the risk of losing money on the way. Paulie has an interesting bonus offer for you if you deposit your money at the bank. Find him below the academy.
You've done as Vascalir asked and talked to Paulie. Remember to always leave your gold on your account! That way there's no risk of losing it.

missions.name: Mission 09: Rock 'n Troll
states: Enter the troll lair to the north of the village and find the new tunnel which the trolls dug and used to infiltrate the Rookgaard academy. There, you need to find a way to destroy it.
Open the chests in the tunnel and use the pick on the 5 beams to weaken the structure and make the tunnel collapse.
You've weakened one of five beams.
You've weakened two of five beams.
You've weakened tree of five beams.
You've weakened four of five beams.
You've weakened all the beams! Hurry out of the tunnel before it collapses!
The tunnel collapsed behind you. Time to return to Vascalir.
Vascalir rewarded you with experience, but there's still something he has to give you. You should talk to him again.
The trolls will not be able to enter the academy via their tunnel again. The village is safe for now - at least from trolls.

missions.name: Mission 10: Tomb Raiding
states: Leave the village to the north and walk south-east to find the haunted graveyard. Descend into the crypt and find a sarcophagus that might still contain a fleshy bone. Bring it to Vascalir.
You've brought the fleshy bone back to Vascalir. Talk to him again to receive your reward.
You managed to get a fleshy bone from the crypt! Who knows what Vascalir plans with it - but this is going to be good.

missions.name: Mission 11: Sweet Poison
states: Leave the village to the north and cross the bridge to the west, then walk south-west to find a wasp lair. Make sure you don't lose the flask Vascalir gave you.
You've found the wasp lair. Kill one wasp and use the empty flask on its dead body to retrieve some of its poison.
You've retrieved some lethal wasp poison. Bring it back to Vascalir to complete the mission.
You brought Vascalir the highly toxic poison. You should talk to him again to receive your reward.
You've retrieved highly toxic wasp poison for Vascalir. It's time for your final challenge.

missions.name: Mission 12: Into The Fortress
states: This is it - the infiltration of the orc fortress and revenge on Kraknaknork awaits. Get the required items from a chest in the academy near the bank.
You've got all items you need to finally kill Kraknaknork. Don't lose them, and carefully make your way towards the orc fortress located in the far west of Rookgaard. Leave the village to the north.
You've knocked out the unsuspecting orc. USE the orc before it wakes up again to disguise yourself as an orc!
Even your mom wouldn't recognise you. You might not be able to fool all orcs in your disguise, but it should be enough to walk past the orc guarding the entrance.
You managed to sneak into the fortress. Use the fleshy bone and click on the elite orc guard with the crosshairs to create a distraction!
The guard is indeed very distracted - he smells delicious. At least to the wild dogs that entered the scene. This is the perfect time to enter the lower levels of the orc fortress.
You're inside the orc fortress! Now you need to find a kitchen and something that looks like a soup cauldron. Use the wasp poison on the cauldron to create an evil surprise for Kraknaknork.
You "spiced up" Kraknaknork's breakfast. Let's see how strong he still is after his meal. Proceed further into the fortress - and keep your tarantula trap ready.
You managed to slow down the furious orc berserker. Now, run through the teleporter while he isn't close to it!
You've entered Kraknaknork's room. Find a way to get rid of the energy barriers.
You solved the riddle of the energy barriers. The way to the throne room should be clear - for a short time. Be prepared for a massive fight!
You've entered Kraknaknork's throne room. Fight him! You can back out at any time via the teleporter, but you'll have to start the battle over. Once he is dead, enter the teleporter near his throne.
You've vanquished Kraknaknork and found his treasure room. You can probably take a few things from there before you leave - he wouldn't care anymore.
With the last bit of Kraknaknork's energy, you were teleported out of the fortress. Time to return to Vascalir victoriously.
You've vanquished Kraknaknork and brought peace to the village of Rookgaard. It will soon be time for you to leave for the Isle of Destiny, choose a vocation and enter the open world of Tibia.

missions.name: Mission 01: A Taste of Things to Come
Mission 01: New Land
states: Explore the new land and reach the bottom of the mountain.
You have found a passage from the mountains. You can report back to Ongulf.
You have reported the scouted route to Ongulf.

missions.name: Mission 02: From Kazordoon With Love
states: Find Melfar of the imperial mining guild close to a mine entrance west of Kazordoon. Ask him to send more miners and wood.
Prepare the three trees which Melfar marked on your map with the beaver bait. Once you've marked all three return to Melfar and tell him about your success.
Melfar has finally promised to send more miners and wood. Report this to Ongulf in Farmine.
You have reported that Melfar will send more miners and wood for Farmine.

missions.name: Mission 03: Strangers in the Night
states: Find the unknown stalkers somewhere in the mountains. They apparently climbed up somewhere during their escape. Try to negotiate a peaceful agreement if possible.
You have talked to the leader of the primitive humans and have assured their peacefulness. Report this to Ongulf back in the base.
You have negotiated a peacful agreement between the dwarfs and the local primitives.

missions.name: Mission 04: The Mine Is Mine
states: Free the mine of the monstrous threat. Use a lift to reach the mines and look for a leader of the stone creatures. Slay this creature and report back to Ongulf.
You have slain the monster that terrorised the mines.

missions.name: Mission 05: Getting Things Busy
states: Try getting the support of the people mentioned. Talk to them about "farmine", then choose the "flatter", "threaten", "impress", "bluff", "reason" or "plea" and report any progress to Ongulf.
You have gained the necessary support for Farmine.

missions.name: Mission 5: Support of Kazordoon's Worm Tamer
states: Talk to the worm tamer in Kazordoon.
Find an item that interests Humgolf to get another chance.

missions.name: Mission 5: Support of the Edron Academy
states: Talk to the magician Wyrdin in the Edron Academy.
Find an item that interests Wyrdin to get another chance.

missions.name: Mission 5: Support of the Explorer Society
states: Talk to the representative of the Explorer Society in Port Hope.
Find an item that interests Angus to get another chance.

missions.name: Mission 5: Support of the Inventor Telas
states: Talk to the inventor Telas in Edron.
Find an item that interests Telas to get another chance.

missions.name: Mission 5: Support of the Thaian King
states: Talk to King Tibianus in the Thaian Castle.
Find an item that interests King Tibianus to get another chance.

missions.name: Mission 5: Support of the Venorean Traders
states: Talk to Leeland Slim, the representative of the Venorean Traders.
Find an item that interests Leeland Slim to get another chance.

missions.name: Mission 06: Days Of Doom
states: Try to pacify the orcs of the steppe. It is probably necessary to find some leader of the orcish tribes.
You have talked to the minotaur leaders of the orcs. They agreed to spare Farmine if you prove your worth in their arena. You will have to survive against Mooh'Tah master for 2 minutes, so prepare!
You have survived the arena. Talk to Curos again about your mission.
Your negotiations had moderate success. Your can report back to Ongulf.
You have ensured a brittle peace between Farmine and the orcs.

missions.name: Mission 07: Messengers Of Peace
states: Find a lizardman somewhere in the north and try to start a negotiation of peace.
It seems that the lizardmen are not interested in peace and you will have to focus on other problems at hand.

missions.name: Mission 08: An Offer You Can't Refuse
states: Captured by lizardmen trap you have to find a way out of the prison. Perhaps something in your cell might lead you to an opportunity for freedom.
You managed to find a way of the captivity of the lizardmen - but for a price.

missions.name: Mission 09: Mortal Combat
states: You are expected to participate in the great tournament of the lizard race. Travel to the Isle of Strife and brave the challenges there.
You are the champion of the great tournament! Still the lizardmen are a menace to behold. You should report to Chrak before you leave the isle.
You have reported your latest doings to Chrak. It seems you bought the dwarfs some time of peace. Only the dragon kings may know how long though.

missions.name: Mission 10: New Horizons
states: Ongulf will be anxious to learn about your latest adventures. Travel back to Farmine for a final report.
Ongulf got very satisfied with your journey, this land is yours to be taken. You can find now on top of the mountain a red carpet, it might offer you access to some cities.

missions.name: Tome of Knowledge Counter
states: You brought the fist Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt more about the lizard culture. Pompan will sell you dragon tapestries from now on.
You brought the second Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt more about the minotaur culture. Pompan will sell you minotaur backpacks from now on.
You brought the third Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt more about the last stand of the draken culture. Esrik will sell you lizard weapon rack from now on.

You brought the fourth Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt something interesting about a certain food that the lizardmen apparently prepare. Swolt will trade you a bunch of ripe rice for 10 rice balls from now on.
You brought the fifth Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt more about the last stand of the lizards in the South, Zzaion. Pompan will sell you lizard backpacks from now on.
You brought the sixth Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt a few things about the primitive human culture on this continent. Cael will sell you War Drums and Didgeridoo from now on.
You brought the seventh Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt something interesting about the Zao steppe. Now you to use the snake teleport at the peak of the mountain.
You brought the eighth Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt a few things about an illness. Now you can enter a corruption hole in the north-eastern end of Zao.
You brought the ninth Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt something interesting about the Draken origin. Esrik will buy lizard equipment from you now.

You brought the tenth Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt more about the last stand of the lizard dynasty. Now you can enter the Zao Palace. It is situated deep underground, below the mountain base of the Lizards.
You brought the eleventh Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt something interesting about dragons and their symbolism. You can buy a Dragon Statue from NPC Cael after you bring him a Red Lantern.

You brought the twelfth Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt something about reveals some of the power structures in Zao. Cael will now make a Dragon Throne for you after you bring him a Red Piece of Cloth. He will reward you with 5000 experience points for each extra tome you give to him.

missions.name: Mission 5: Support of Kazordoon's Worm Tamer
Mission 5: Support of the Edron Academy
Mission 5: Support of the Explorer Society
Mission 5: Support of the Inventor Telas
Mission 5: Support of the Thaian King
Mission 5: Support of the Venorean Traders
Mission 08: An Offer You Can't Refuse
Method
states: Use the item on the tombstones.
You have used these item in the tombstones.

states.3: Talk to Sinclair and take the ghost residue.
states.4: You got the ghost waste.

states.5: You need to get more samples of ghosts.
states.6: You got all the ghost scraps.

missions.name: Troubled Animals
states: You met the talking white deer Alkestios. It turned out he is actually a fae - and needs help. Search out a poacher camp noth of the Green Claw Swamps and keep the poachers from hunting white deers.
You found a book with legends in the poacher camp. You asked Ahmed to add a story about how it brings ill luck to kill a white deer, hopefully the poachers will desist from hunting Alkestios.
You returned to the poacher camp and placed the faked book noticeably on a table. You're quite sure the poachers will discover it soon and desist from hunting Alkestios.
Alkestios asked you for help on another issue. There seemms to be a problem with a wolf mother and her whelps. Find the snake Ikassis in the north-west of Edron and talk to her, she knows more.
The snake Ikassis asked you to find a female wolf in the south of Cormaya. The animal is in need of help, yet Ikassis didn't know any details.
You found the ghostly wolf and promised to search for her lost whelps. The wolf told you to start your search at Ulderek's Rock
At Ulderek's Rock you found a sleeping war wolf. It might actually be the now grown up whelp you were looking for. The skeleton nearby implies that the hunter didn't survive his misdeed.
You talked to Irmana in Venore and she gave you the fur of one of the wolf whelps you're searching for. You should talk to their mother's ghost.
As the ghostly wolf asked you, you placed the whelp fur in the mouth of a nearby stone, that is shaped like a big face.
You redeemed the ghostly wolf. You should return to Ikassis and tell her about it.
Ikassis was happy to hear that you redeemed the ghostly wolf. But she asked you to help someone else: one of her sisters. You can find her in the guise of swan at a river sourth-east of Ikassis.
You met a swan that in truth is a swan maiden, a kind of fae. These fae have magical cloaks that allow them to shape change between swan and girl. Find this maiden's cloak that was stolen by a troll.
The troll Grarkharok sold the cloak to Tereban and he lost it during a flight with magic carpet. The cloak's feathers are now scattered along the carpet's beeline between Edron and Darashia.
You found many swan feathers on Edron and in Darama desert. Now you should have enough for an entire cloak. You should talk to the swan maiden.
You found enough magical swan feathers. The swan maiden will now be able to restore her cloak. You should talk to Alkestios again.
Alkestios was very happy about your support. You earned the Fae's trust and may now enter their secret realm. Search for an elemental shrine of ice, fire, earth or energy to reach Feyrist.

missions.name: Nightmare Intruders

strings: The fae queen asked for your help: Feyrist is threatened by intruders from Roshamuul. Kill 200 nightmare monsters and Kroazur. - You killed %d weakened frazzlemaws and %d efeebled silencers.

states: You killed 200 of the nightmare monsters that are invading Feyrist. Maelyrra was very happy but it seems she still has other problems. She may need your help once more.
Maelyrra asked you to retrieve an artefact for her: the moon mirror. It was stolen by the tainted fae who inhabit the caves underneath Feyrist. She also asked you to free some captured fairies.
You found the moon mirror and freed the captured fairies. Maelyrra was very happy but it seems she has another problem. Perhaps you should offer your assistance once more.
The barrier that protects Feyrist from the outside world is weakened. To strengthen it again you need to find the starlight vial and the sun catcher. Ask Aurita and Taegen for these items.
Gather sunlight, starlight and moon rays. You have to do this with the sun catcher on the beach, with the starlight vial high in the mountains and with the moon mirror on a glade in the forest.
You may now repair the barrier. Charge the five moon sculptures of Feyrist with moon rays, the five dreambird trees with starlight and the five sun mosics with sunlight.
You repaired tha magical barrier that protects Feyrist from the outside world. The fae's secret realm is safe again.

missions.name: An Unlikely Couple
states: Help Aurita and Taegen and find a spell to transform Aurita's fishtail into legs temporarily. A fairy in a small fae village in the southwest of Feyrist might know more.
You have succesfully created the magical music notes for the mermaid Aurita. Talk to the faun Taegen, he also needs your help.
The faun Taegen wants to spend some time with his lover, the mermaid Aurita. He wants to visit her home and thus must be able to breath under water. Therefore he needs the rare raven herb.
You found the rare raven herb and gave it to Taegen. Now he will create a sun catcher for you. You may also ask Aurita for the starlight vial now.

missions.name: The Fairy Treasure
states: The Tooth Fairy asked you to deliver presents to three children who recently lost a milk tooth. Visit Quero's daughter's room in Thais, Allen's son's room in Venore and Rowenna's daughter's room in Carlin. Place a present on each bed and collect the milk tooth from under the pillow. Return to the Tooth Fairy with the three milk teeth.
You delivered the presents and collected the milk teeth. The Tooth Fairy rewarded you with the first part of an old map. Now find the Tired Tree north of the Fields of Glory and ask it for a mission.

missions.name: Tired Trees
states: The Tired Tree north of the Fields of Glory asked for a bedtime story about Dryads. Find the book 'The Seeds of Life' and recite its name to the tree.
You told the Tired Tree the story of 'The Seeds of Life' and received the second part of the old map. Now find the Grumpy Stone between Kazordoon and Femor Hills and ask it for a mission.

missions.name: Beset Stones
states: The Grumpy Stone between Kazordoon and Femor Hills asked you to scratch the backs of its five siblings. Use a rake (no metal!) on all five sentient stones around it, then report back.

You scratched the backs of all five stones and received the third part of the old map. The Grumpy Stone told you the fourth part is hidden in a Big Fly Agaric in the Fields of Glory, south of the Tired Tree.
You found the fourth map part hidden between the gills of the Big Fly Agaric in the Fields of Glory. Use any of the four map parts to combine them into the complete Old Map.
You assembled the Old Map. It tells you to search for a stone sun mosaic in the very south of Thais.
You discovered the fairy treasure hidden beneath the stones of the sun mosaic: a Butterfly Ring, 5 Rainbow Quartz and 5 Ancient Coins.

missions.name: Tooth Collection
states: The Tooth Fairy asked you to complete her collection. Bring her: an Orc Tooth, Shark Teeth, Vampire Teeth, a Perfect Behemoth Fang, a Carrion Worm Fang and Werewolf Fangs.
You delivered all the teeth for the Tooth Fairy's collection and received the Toothfairy Assistant achievement.

missions.name: The Swan Feather Cloak
states: Valindara agreed to craft a Swan Feather Cloak for you. Collect 100 Swan Feathers from the eight spots around Feyrist near the swans Once you have them all, return to Valindara.
You delivered 100 Swan Feathers to Valindara and received your Swan Feather Cloak.

missions.name: Mission 01: Gaining Trust
states: Think of a way to earn Julius' trust and prove that you are not a vampire. Once you have thought of something, talk to him again about your mission.
Julius wants more proof. He asked if you have ever baked garlic bread. Confirm whether you know how to bake it.
Bake a garlic bread by using holy water on flour, then use the dough on garlic, and bake it in an oven. Bring it back to Julius and eat it in front of him.
You have earned Julius' trust.

missions.name: Mission 02: Bad Eggs
states: Bake garlic cookies by using the garlic dough on a baking tray before putting it in the oven. Hand out cookies to the citizens and watch their reactions. Report any suspicious people to Julius.
You have reported five suspects — probably vampires — to Julius.

missions.name: Mission 03: His True Face
states: Use the magic words 'alori mort' in front of the five suspicious citizens to reveal who among them is their leader.
You used the spell on all five suspects. Report your findings to Julius.
You reported the incident with Armenius to Julius.

missions.name: Mission 04: The Dark Lands
states: Find someone to bring you to Vengoth. Explore the island and use Julius' map whenever you find an unusual spot to mark it. Mark at least 5 spots including the castle and report back to Julius.
You have successfully mapped Vengoth and reported back to Julius.

missions.name: Mission 05: Into the Castle
states: Find a blood crystal somewhere in Yalahar. Ask around to find out where you could get one.
Charge the blood crystal by finding someone who has lost something or someone dear to them. Their grief emits powerful energy.
Gather three more adventurers with charged blood crystals. Stand together on the four symbols around Vengoth castle to attune yourselves and unlock the gate. Report back to Julius.
You entered the castle but were blocked by invulnerable ghosts. Search for documents and books inside that reveal the history of the castle and its masters.

missions.name: Mission 06: A Black History
states: Explore the castle further. Search for hidden passages and look for documents or books that reveal the dark history of the castle and its masters.
You have uncovered the black history of the vampire brothers. Report your findings to Julius and explore deeper to find Boreth, the first of the four brothers.

missions.name: Mission 07: Boreth
states: Find Boreth, the first of the four vampire brothers, hidden somewhere in the castle. Defeat him and bring Julius proof of his death.
You have defeated Boreth, the first of the four vampire brothers.

missions.name: Mission 08: Lersatio
states: Defeat Lersatio, the second vampire brother. He lurks in another tower of the castle. Use his mirrors to shatter them and lure him out. Bring Julius proof of his death.
You have defeated Lersatio, the second vampire brother.

missions.name: Mission 09: Marziel
states: Defeat Marziel, the third vampire brother. Find access to his tower. A female character must step onto the throne carrying a vial of blood to awaken him. Bring Julius proof of his death.
You have defeated Marziel, the third vampire brother.

missions.name: Mission 10: Arthei
states: Defeat Arthei, the master vampire brother. Find him in the deepest part of the castle and bring Julius proof of his death.
You have defeated all four vampire brothers and freed Yalahar from their curse. Julius rewarded you with a special crest.

strings: Prevent the raising of twelve lich knights. Sanctify the graves yet untouched and destroy any lich knights that might have been raised. Graves exlored: %d/12

missions.name: 01 The grave in Edron
states: Find the grave in Edron's north.
The Edron grave was visited.

missions.name: 02 The grave in the dark cathedral
states: Find the grave in the dark cathedral.
The grave in the dark cathedral was visited.

missions.name: 03 The grave in Ghostlands
states: Find the grave in the ghostlands.
The grave in the Ghostlands was visited.

missions.name: 04 The grave in Cormaya
states: Find the grave in Cormaya.
The grave in Cormaya was visited.

missions.name: 05 The grave in the Femor Hills
states: Find the grave in the Femor Hills.
The grave in the Femor Hills was visited.

missions.name: 06 The grave on an isle NE of Ankrahmun
states: Find the grave on an isle north-east of Ankrahmun.
The grave on an isle north-east of Ankrahmun was visited.

missions.name: 07 The grave in Kilmaresh
states: Find the grave in Kilmaresh.
The grave in Kilmaresh was visited.

missions.name: 08 The grave in Vengoth
states: Find the grave in Vengoth.
The grave in Vengoth was visited.

missions.name: 09 The grave in Darashia
states: Find the grave in Darashia.
The grave in Darashia was visited.

missions.name: 10 The grave in the old Thais temple
states: Find the grave in the old Thais temple.
The grave in the old temple of Thais has been visited.

missions.name: 11 The grave at the orclands entrance
states: Find the grave at the orclands entrance.
The grave at the orcland entrance was visited.

missions.name: 12 The grave on the southern ice islands
states: Find the grave on the southern ice islands.
The grave on the southern ice islands was visited.

missions.name: The Order of the Cobra
states: Scarlett Etzel once stood proud and righteous. The assassins she rallied around her under the Order of the Cobra, however, where of ill repute and had to be vanquished. And so did she, you prevailed.

missions.name: 02 The grave in the dark cathedral
05 The grave in the Femor Hills
06 The grave on an isle NE of Ankrahmun
10 The grave in the old Thais temple
11 The grave at the orclands entrance
12 The grave on the southern ice islands
Outlaw Treasure
missions.description: You made your way through the Outlaw Camp and found the hidden treasure of the bandits.

missions.name: High and Dry
states: Dedoras asked for you to talk to Charles, he knows about a small island.
You got stucked on this island. You must discover how to leave.
You successfully built a raft and used the starts to navigate your way through the waves. At least you found something of interest on the deserted island.
Congratulations you completed this mission.

missions.name: Liquid Death
states: Dedoras has sent you to Spectulus in the Edron Academy. Rumors of strange fishmen in the Tiquanda region may be connected to some of the research the scholar conducted.
Spectulus asked you to check out the rumors of strange fishmen in the jungles of northern Tiquanda. A small sunken temple is said to be overrun by strange fish-like creatures.
You found a sunken temple deep in the Tiquanda jungle. Spectulus will help you enter the vortex at the entrance. Find out what happened there and take care of the fish-like aggressors...
Part IV
Part V
Part VI
Brokul has been defeated and now you can talk with Spectulus or Dedoras what you found about the fishmen.
Congratulations you completed this mission.

missions.name: Asuri - The Lament
states: Go to Asuri Palace in Port Hope.
You were able to assemble an instrument with the objects found. That should work for something.
You must talk with the dead girl's mother, Gail, at Port Hope.

With a heavy heart you used a piece of ebony as well as the skull and hair of an unfortunate maiden to create a bone fiddle. By playing the Peacock Ballad you should be able to open the viollet portal.
You may enter the viollet portal. Check if there is something useful there.
In a secret room of the Asura Palace you discovered an old writing desk that contains an ancient map. This must be a hint to the secret library you are searching for.
Congratulations you completed this mission.

missions.name: The Order of the Falcon
states: It is said that an ancient order of knights once resided in Edron. The knights disappeared a long time ago but their abandoned outpost is still there. The place may yet hold some surprises.
You defeated Grand Master Oberon in mortal combat. The Falcon Order may have lost its glory a long time ago but you are just getting started.
Congratulations you completed this mission.

missions.name: The Path of Defiances
states: Go to Darashia and find out about the mysterious statue.
After you have been swallowed by a sand vortex you have entered a hidden desert area. A voice of unknown origin has informed you that you will have to face some challenges.
Part III
Part IV
Part V

states:
Sterling told you that his turtle Matilda can take you from Targuna to the pirate island Aragonia, whenever you're ready.
Travel to Aragonia and take care of the pirates and save Morla in the process.

strings:
You've arrived in Aragonia. Help Sterling and his friend Morla by saving the tortoise eggs scattered around the island and taking care of the local pirate problem.

You already killed %d/20 pirates and saved %d/10 tortoise eggs.

Report back to Morla once your objective is completed. You can find her in a small cave on the south side of Aragonia.

states:
After talking to Morla and assuring her that she and her eggs will stay safe from now on, she handed you an old map she stole from one of the sleeping pirates.

Travel back to Targuna and show Sterling the mysterious treasure map and let him decipher it.

Sterling deciphered the map and told you about the spot on Targuna.
The long lost treasure can be found for those who have their eyes open and their hearts pure.
Look for a hidden place on the island where water and rocks meet.

You found the marked spot on Targuna and dug into the sand. Beneath it, a hidden entrance to a previously unknown cave was revealed.

At the end of the cave you find the long forgotten treasure chest ready to be opened.

Take what is hidden inside as your reward for your hard work and service to Sterling, Morla and Targuna as a whole.

missions.name: An Ancient Enemy
states:
You heard about a growing lizard clan hidden deep inside a temple under Targuna.
Talk to Lizzie in order to get more information on how to find these lizards and what to be careful of.
You can find Lizzie on the southside of Targuna.

strings:
After talking to Lizzie you received all necessary information about the lizard group on Targuna.
Your mission is now to eliminate the Lizard Commander and put an end to his reign.

You've eliminated %d/1 Lizard Commander.

Inform Lizzie after eliminating your target.

states:
You finally put an end to the reign of the Lizard Commander.
Based on Lizzie's research, this lizard group will soon dissolve and won't be a threat again.

Talk to the mayor, Camilla, about your work. You can find her in the upper levels of the depot.

You've told Camilla about the Hidden Lizard Temple under Targuna and the research Lizzie was involved in to uncover the danger hidden beneath.

Camilla, Lizzie and all citizens of Targuna are grateful for your efforts, ensuring the town stays safe for years to come.

missions.name: Burning Heat
states:
Emiliana asked you to help her fight the danger lingering within the portal.
Use the teleporter in her upstairs room to travel into the Crimson Court and speak to Emiliana again to discuss your further plans.

You've reached the Crimson Court and talked to Emiliana about your next actions.
She tasked you to make your way deeper into the crater.
Find out where the uprising demonic force called Herald of Fire resides and destroy his growing kingdom in order to save Targuna and its residents.

At last his kingdom comes to an end as you feel the power bursting from the remains of the Herald of Fire.
Take what's now rightfully yours and travel back to Emiliana on Targuna to discuss further actions.

As a sign of gratitude for your service, Emiliana gifted you a bunch of turnips, hinting at the wild ram living behind the bakery on Targuna. Emiliana seems to know how much these creatures enjoy the taste of fresh roots.

Visit the ram and use the given bunch of turnips to feed the hungry mammal.

You used the bunch of turnips on the ram in Targuna. It enjoyed your gift so much that it will now follow you as a partner in crime after helping Emiliana and the citizens of the island by taking care of the Herald of Fire.

Where will you and your new wandering partner head next?

missions.name: Mission 3: Zee Killing Fieldzz

The rice has been poisoned. This will weaken the Emperor's army significantly. Return and tell Zalamon about your success.
You already reported Zalamon about your success! Ask him for new mission!

missions.name: Mission 4: Zze Way of Zztonezz

Report Zalamon about the strange symbols that you found.
Get the greasy oil from Zalamon's storage room and put them on the levers that you found.
Due to being extra greasy, the leavers can now be moved.
You found the right combination for the puzzle in the mountains and triggered some kind of mechanism. You should head back to Zalamon to report your success.
You already reported Zalamon about your success! You got a Tome of Knowledge as reward! Ask him for new mission!

missions.name: Mission 5: Phantom Army
states: Zalamon has sent you on a quest to find out what lies beneath the secret portal in the temple. Find it and explore the other side.
Eternal guardians and lizard chosen has been awaken. Survive them and report it to Zalamon!
You Survived the Waves and reported Zalamon about your success! You got a Serpent Crest as reward!

missions.name: The Marid and the Efreet - Djinn Greeting
states: Melchior told you the word "Djanni'hah" which can be used to talk to Djinns. Be aware that once you become an ally of one Djinn race, you cannot switch sides anymore.

missions.name: The Marid and the Efreet - Marid Faction
states: You have joined the Marid. These friendly, blue Djinns are honest and fair allies. You have pledged eternal loyalty to King Gabel and may enter Asha'daramai freely. Djanni'hah!

missions.name: The Efreet and the Efreet - Efreet Faction
states: You have joined the Efreet. These evil, green Djinns are always up to mischievous pranks. You have pledged eternal loyalty to King Malor and may enter Mal'ouquah freely. Djanni'hah!

missions.name: The Mermaid Marina
states: Marina, the mermaid north of Sabrehaven sends you to bring her 50 honeycombs. After this she will help you create spool of yarn.
Marina, the mermaid north of Sabrehaven will help you to create a spool of yarn from 10 pieces of spider silk. Just ask her if you need something.

missions.name: The Blessed Stake
states: Quentin told you about an old prayer which can bind holy energy to an object. Each of its ten lines has to be recited by a different priest though. Bring Quentin a wooden stake from Gamon to start.
You received Quentin's prayer: "Light shall be near - and darkness afar". Now, bring your stake to Tibra in the Carlin church for the next line of the prayer.
You received Tibra's prayer: "Hope may fill your heart - doubt shall be banned". Now, bring your stake to Maealil in the Elven settlement for the next line of the prayer.
You received Maealil's prayer: "Peace may fill your soul - evil shall be cleansed". Now, bring your stake to Yberius in the Venore temple for the next line of the prayer.
You received Yberius' prayer: "Protection will be granted - from dangers at hand". Now, bring your stake to Isimov in the dwarven settlement for the next line of the prayer.
You received Isimov's prayer: "Unclean spirits shall be repelled". Now, bring your stake to Amanda in Edron for the next line of the prayer.
You received Amanda's prayer: "Wicked curses shall be broken". Now, bring your stake to Kasmir in Darashia for the next line of the prayer.
You received Kasmir's prayer: "Let there be honor and humility". Now, bring your stake to Rahkem in Ankrahmun for the next line of the prayer.
You received Rahkem's prayer: "Let there be power and compassion". Now, bring your stake to Brewster in Port Hope for the next line of the prayer.
You received Brewster's prayer: "Your hand shall be guided - your feet shall walk in harmony". Now, bring your stake to Tyrias in Liberty Bay for the next line of the prayer.
You received Tyrias' prayer: "Your mind shall be a vessel for joy, light and wisdom". He wasn't exactly happy though and said that if you need some mumbo jumbo again, you should rather go to Chondur.
Chondur was surprised to hear that you had to travel through all of Tibia to have your wooden stake blessed. He offered you help with the blessing if you should need one again in the future.

missions.name: Mission 03: Death to the Deathbringer
states: Get the notes in Palimuths room and read them. Talk to Palimuth again when you've read the notes.
Talk to Azerus the Yalahari in the city centre to get your next mission.

missions.name: Mission 04: Good to be Kingpin
states: Ask Palimuth for mission.

missions.name: Mission 05: Food or Fight
states: Ask Palimuth for mission.
On this mission you are asked to find a druid by the name of Tamerin, on the Arena Quarter. You now have permission to use the gates mechanism.
The first is to bring Tamerin a flask of Animal Cure, you can buy this from Siflind on Nibelor (northeast of Svargrond).
now you have to kill Morik the Gladiator and bring his helmet to Tamerin as proof.

Report back to Tamerin as he will listen to your request and you can now make your choice: Cattle for Palimuth (good side), Warbeasts for Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side). Then report the one you decided your mission.
You decided to help Palimuth, report him your mission.

Ask Azerus for a mission.

missions.name: Mission 06: Frightening Fuel
states: Ask Palimuth for mission.

Yalahari (Azerus) orders you to travel to the Cemetery Quarter and find the Strange Carving. He gives you a Ghost Charm and tells you to charge it with the tormented souls of the ghosts there to be used as an energy source. Palimuth wants the Charged Ghost Charm in order to free those souls. You can new use the Cemetery Quarter mechanism now. Go to the big building in the Cemetery Quarter and use the Ghost Charm on the Strange Carving at the back of the room.
Good side: Go to Palimuth, ask him about your mission, and hand in the charm. Bad side: Ask about your mission to Yalahari (Azerus) and give it back.
Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
Ask Azerus for a mission.

missions.name: Mission 07: A Fishy Mission
states: Ask Palimuth for mission.

Bad side: Yalahari (Azerus) will send you for a new mission to go to the Sunken Quarter and kill the Quara Leaders, Inky, Splasher and Sharptooth. Good side: Rather than fighting any Quara leaders Palimuth will instead send you to find the cause for the Quaras aggressive behavior. Find Maritima and talk to her about the Quara and she will explain what their problem is.
Get back to Palimuth and report him your mission.
You killed the Quarabosses. Ask Azerus for a mission.
Ask Azerus for a mission.

missions.name: Mission 08: Dangerous Machinations
states: Ask Palimuth for mission.

Bad side: For this mission the Yalahari requests you go to the Factory Quarter and find a pattern crystal, which will be used to supply weapons to help take control of the city. Good side: Palimuth will send you there to use the crystal to supply food for the city.
Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
Ask Azerus for a mission.

missions.name: Mission 09: Decision
states: You now need to decide between supporting Palimuth or the Yalahari's goal. To choose Palimuth's good side go to him, and simply ask him for a mission mission. Likewise, to join the Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side) go to him and say the same.
you already decided!

missions.name: Mission 10: The Final Battle
states: Palimuth told you that a circle of Yalahari is planning some kind of ritual. They plan to create a portal for some powerful demons and to unleash them in the city to 'purge' it once and for all.
The entrance to their inner sanctum has been opened for you. Be prepared for a HARD battle! Better gather some friends to assist you.
Report back to whichever principal you have chosen to help and you will receive Yalaharian Outfits.

states.1: You have a vague idea that Zirella might need you for collecting firewood, but you don't know yet where to get it. You should talk to her again.
