states: Fa'hradin asked you to sneak into the Efreet fortress Mal'ouqhah and find their undercover spy. The codeword is PIEDPIPER.
You have delivered the spyreport. Fa'hradin seemed impressed and told you that Gabel himself might have another mission for you.

missions.name: Rata'Mari and the Cheese
states: You have promised Rata'Mari cheese. Once you deliver some to him, he will hand over his spyreport.
You got Rata'Mari's spyreport. He seems to be quite happy with the cheese you brought him.

missions.name: Marid Mission 3: The Sleeping Lamp
states: Gabel asked you to find Fa'hradin's sleeping lamp in the orc fortress at Ulderek's Rock. Then, sneak into Mal'ouqhah and exchange Malor's sleeping lamp with Fa'hradin's lamp.
You successfully exchanged the lamps. Gabel will be happy to hear about this.
The Marid deeply appreciate your help. King Gabel allowed you to trade with Haroun and Nah'bob.

missions.name: Going Down
states: Deliver 3 Gear Wheels to Xorlosh.
You sucessfully helped Xorlosh in repairing the elevator. You can now enter the teleporter to the eastern part of the mine.

missions.name: Justice for All
states: Nokmir told you that he is falsely accused of being a thief. You could help him by talking to Grombur about the case. Furthermore you should try to find that ring which belongs to Rerun.
You should talking to Grombur about Nokmir.
You should try to find that ring which belongs to Rerun everywhere in the mine.
You have found Rerun's ring. Bring the ring to the emperor Rehal and talk to him about Nokmir.
You informed emperor Rehal about your recent discoveries and he acquitted Nokmir of being a thief.
You told Nokmir about his acquittal and he granted you access to the northern mine.

missions.name: Pythius the Rotten
states: You won the battle against the malicious undead dragon Pythius the Rotten. He granted you firewalker boots as a reward.

missions.name: Sweet as Chocolate Cake
states: Bake a Chocolate Cake and bring it to Bolfona at the bar.
Report back to Frafnar by telling him about the mission.
You told Frafnar that you did everything he asked you to do. You may now enter the western part of the mine.

missions.name: The Good Guard
states: Grombur asked you to get him a cask of dwarven brown ale. You heard that Boozer in Venore tried to brew some. Maybe you should pay him a visit.
Grombur liked the ale and you are now allowed to enter his part of the mine.

missions.name: Befriending the Musher
states: Find Sniffler the husky of Iskan. He should be somewhere north west of the town. He is probably marking his territory so you should be able to find his trace. Call him sniffler and feed him with meat.
Tell Iskan that you found and feed Sniffler
You are now a friend of Iskan and can ask him for a passage to Nibelor. You should ask Hjaern in Nibelor if you can help him.

missions.name: Nibelor 1: Breaking the Ice
states: Chakoyas may use the ice for a passage to the west and attack Svargrond. Use the rocks at east of nibelor on at least three of these places and the chakoyas probably won't be able to pass the ice.
You have broke 1 of 3 icepassages
You have broke 2 of 3 icepassages
You have broke 3 of 3 icepassages! Tell Hjaern your mission!
You should ask Silfind if you can help her in some matters.

missions.name: Nibelor 2: Ecological Terrorism
states: Siflind send you to travel to a distant land to get ants from an Ant-Hill to perform ecological terrorism on some pirates on Tyrsung. Just use the jug on an anthill.

Now head back to Svargrond and go to Buddel, the drunk sailor in southern Svargrond, and ask him to take you to Tyrsung. Now go all the way to the southern shores where you find a outpost. Go to the bottom deck and use the jug with the western mast
Go tell Siflind that you released the ants and aks her for mission!

missions.name: Nibelor 3: Artful Sabotage
states: Siflind gave you a Vial of Paint to use on some Baby Seals. Go back to Tyrsung and follow the shore from Buddel south. Use the Vial of Paint on three of these seals.
Go tell Siflind that you painted the seals and aks her for mission!

missions.name: Nibelor 4: Berserk Brewery
states: The first things needed are 5 bat wings to brew a berserker elixir. Bring her them!
The next items Siflind need are 4 bear paws. Bring her them!
The next items Siflind need are 3 bonelord eyes. Bring her them!
The next items Siflind need are 2 fish fins. Bring her them!
The next item Siflind need is a green dragon scale. Bring her that!
You helped Siflind to defend Svargrond. Now Nilsor need help, go ask him for mission.

missions.name: Nibelor 5: Cure the Dogs
states: To cure Nilsor dogs, bring him the 1st of 7 ingredients: a Part of the Sun Adorer Cactus. Only an ordinary kitchen knife will be precise enough to produce the ingredient weneed.
To cure Nilsor dogs, bring him the 2nd of 7 ingredients: Geyser Water in a Waterskin. Use it on a geyser that is NOT active. The water of active geysers is far too hot.
To cure Nilsor dogs, bring him the 3rd of 7 ingredients: Fine Sulphur. Use an ordinary kitchen spoon on an inactive lava hole.
To cure Nilsor dogs, bring him the 4th of 7 ingredients: the Frostbite Herb. You can find it on mountain peaks. You will need to cut it with a fine kitchen knife.

To cure Nilsor dogs, bring him the 5th of 7 ingredients: Purple Kiss Blossom. The purple kiss is a plant that grows in a place called jungle. You will have to use a kitchen knife to harvest its blossom.
To cure Nilsor dogs, bring him the 6th of 7 ingredients: the Hydra Tongue. The hydra tongue is a common pest plant in warmer regions. You might find one in a shop.

To cure Nilsor dogs, bring him the 7th of 7 ingredients: Spores of a Giant Glimmercap Mushroom. The giant glimmercap mushroom exists in caves and other preferably warm and humid places. Use an ordinary kitchen spoon on a mushroom to collectits spores.
You found all ingredients to cure Nilsor dogs, ask him for mission. You can now travel by Dog Sleds to Inukaya.

missions.name: The Secret of Helheim
states: Hjaern might have a mission for you. So maybe you go and talk to him.
Hjaern send you to find someone in Svargrond who can give you a passage to Helheim and seek the reason for the unrest there.
You discovered the necromantic altar and should report Hjaern about it.

missions.name: The Contact
states: Get out of Nibelor and go to the Svargrond Explorer's Society. Ask Lurik for the mission.
Get to the raider camp, then follow to the extreme south where you find lots of barbarians. Near the southern most coastline, try looking for the NPC Nor. Ask him about Memory Crystal.
Go back to Lurik and deliver him the memory crystal.
Give Lurik some time to evaluate the information (ca. 5min). Then talk to him again about your mission.

missions.name: Formorgar Mines 1: The Mission
states: Find the entrance of the Formorgar Mines. Find some hint or someone who is willing to talk about what is going on there.
You found a old and tattered written paper in a skeleton next to a Restless Soul, you can only make out a signature: Tylaf, apprentice of Hjaern. Ask Hjaern about Tylaf.

missions.name: Formorgar Mines 2: Ghostwhisperer
states: Go back to the mine and ask the restless soul about his story.
You already have listen to his story!

missions.name: Formorgar Mines 3: The Secret
states: The Cultists plan is to create a new demon army for their master to conquer the world. Hjaern and the other shamans must learn about it! Hurry before its too late.
The Cultists plan is to create a new demon army for their master to conquer the world. Hjaern and the other shamans are already informed!

missions.name: Formorgar Mines 4: Retaliation
states: Hjaern gave you a spirit charm of cold. Travel to the mines and find four special obelisks to mark them with the charm.
1 of 4 obelisks are marked.
2 of 4 obelisks are marked.
3 of 4 obelisks are marked.
Once all 4 obelisks are marked report back to Hjaern.
You got the Norseman outfit and you have access to the Yakchal room deep in the Formorgar Mines.

missions.name: Barbarian Test 1: Barbarian Booze
states: You participate in the drinking challenge. Now you can get the permission for a few sips of barbarian mead in exchange for some honey.
Now drink from the bucket until you drink 10 sips in a row without passing out
You have mastered the first task of the barbarian test. If you haven't done so yet, talk to Sven about it.

missions.name: Barbarian Test 2: The Bear Hugging
states: Somewhere north of Svargrond you will find a lonely bear which you have to hug. You wonder what you were thinking when accepting this quest...
You passed the bear hugging test (and should take a bath). If you haven't done so yet, talk to Sven about it.

missions.name: Barbarian Test 3: The Mammoth Pushing
states: Find a mammoth north-west of Svargrond and knock it over. You wonder whether your mission is becoming a barbarian or rather commiting suicide.
You have knocked over a mammoth - though you wonder what this crushing noise at your spine was. If you haven't done so yet, talk to Sven about the mammoth pushing.

states.8: You are now a honorary barbarian and can become a citizen of Svargrond. If you haven't done so yet, you should look for a barbarian in need of help in the north of the town.

missions.name: Mission 1: Interrogation
states: Your mission is to investigate the 5 guards in Thais regarding the Heretic behavior. Tim, Kulag, Grof, Miles and Walter are their names. If you do well you see a holy sprite on you.
You investigated 1 of 5 guards in Thais.
You investigated 2 of 5 guards in Thais.
You investigated 3 of 5 guards in Thais.
You investigated 4 of 5 guards in Thais.
You investigated 5 of 5 guards in Thais. Get back to Thais and report your mission to Henricus.
You investigated all guards in Thais.

missions.name: Mission 2: Eclipse
states: Henricus tells you to get The Witches' Grimoire, he sends you to Femor Hills where you can fly to the witches' mountain, say Eclipse to Uzon and he will take you there. Use the vial of holy water that he gives you on the big cauldron and open the chest to your left, then bring the witches' grimoire to Henricus.
Find the witches' grimoire and bring it to Henricus.
You already brought the witches' grimoire to Henricus.

missions.name: Mission 3: Vampire Hunt
states: Henricus wants you to find the Dwarfish Vampire Hunter, Storkus, located west of the Dwarf Bridge. It's good idea bring your 20 Vampire Dusts with you to save some time.
Go Back to Storkus the Dwarf and ask for Mission.

Now Storkus wants you to kill a vampire lord, The Count in the Green Claw Swamp, The Count is located near to the Blood Herb Quest. To summon The Count, you must use the coffin in the center of the room. Kill it and bring The Ring of the Count to Storkus.
Kill The Count and bring his ring to Storkus the Dwarf and ask for Mission.
Return to Henricus and tell him that you finished your job here.
Get back to Thais and report your mission to Henricus.

missions.name: Mission 4: The Haunted Ruin
states: Henricus will gave you a Special Flask (vial of holy water). Go to Liberty Bay and use the vial on an old house. Use this vial of holy water on that spot to drive out the evil being.
Kill the Pirate Ghost and get back to Thais and report your mission to Henricus.
You already cleaned the abandoned and haunted house in Liberty, ask Henricus for mission.

missions.name: Mission 5: Essential Gathering
states: Henricus wants 20 Demonic Essences as a proof of your accomplishments.
Now ask Henricus for outfit to get the Demon Hunter Outfit.
You got the Demon Hunter Outfit! Ask Henricus for mission to unlock more addons.

missions.name: Mission 6: The Demon Ungreez
states: Henricus wants you to kill a demon called Ungreez. Head to Edron Hero Cave and go down a few levels.
You killed Ungreez, report your mission to Henricus.
You got the the first addon of Demon Hunter Outfit! Ask Henricus for mission to unlock more addons.

missions.name: Mission 7: The Shadow Nexus
states: Your mission is to go to the Demon Forge and slay seven of The Ruthless Seven Minions. The Demon Forge is located in the Edron Hero Cave, through a portal after the Vampire Shield Quest.
You destroyed the shadow nexus! Get back to Thais and report your mission to Henricus.
Now ask to Henricus for a outfit. He will give you the 2nd addon of the Demon Hunter Outfits.
You got the the second addon of Demon Hunter Outfit! Go now to the reward room and choose one wisely!
You have completed The Inquisition Quest! You can now buy the Blessing of the Inquisition!

missions.name: Mission 01 - Check Postal Routes
states: Kevin wants you to travel with Captain Bluebear to Carlin.
Kevin wants you to travel with Uzon in Femor Hills to Edron.
Kevin wants you to travel with Captain Seahorse to Venore.
Kevin wants you to travel with Brodrosch to Cormaya
You have checked the Postal Routes, report back to Kevin!
You have reported back that you have completed the mission.

missions.name: Mission 02 - Fix Mailbox
states: Kevin wants you to fix one of their Mailboxes located on Folda with a crowbar.
You have fixed the mailbox, report back to Kevin!
You have reported back that you have completed the mission.

missions.name: Mission 03 - Bill Delivery
states: Kevin wants you to deliver a bill to the stage magician David Brassacres. He's hiding from his creditors somewhere in Venore.
You have delivered the bill to the stage magician David Brassacres, report back to Kevin!
You have reported back that you have completed the mission.

missions.name: Mission 04 - Aggressive Dogs
states: Kevin has asked you to deliver 20 Bones to him.
You have delivered 20 Bones to Kevin.

missions.name: Mission 05 - Present Delivery
states: Kevin has asked you to retrieve the present behind the door on the lower right side of his room and deliver it to Dermot in Fibula.
Deliver the present to Dermot in Fibula.
You have delivered the present to Dermot, report back to Kevin!
You have reported back that you have completed the mission.

missions.name: Mission 06 - New Uniforms
states: Kevin has asked you to travel to Venore and negotiate with Hugo for new uniforms.
Hugo said that his dog ate the last dress pattern they used and he has no clue where Kevin Postner got it from, go ask Kevin.
Kevin wants you to ask the great Technomancer Talphion in Kazordoon for the technical details.
Talphion will send a copy to Kevin, report back to Kevin.
Kevin wants you to ask Queen Eloise of Carlin for the perfect colours.
Queen Eloise said she will send some color samples via mail to Kevin, report back to Kevin.
Kevin has asked you to go to Noodles and find out what he dislikes the most: mouldy cheese, a piece of fur or a banana skin.
Noodles seems to like banana skin, check if he likes dirty fur.
Noodles seems to like dirty fur, check if he likes mouldy cheese.
Noodles dislikes mouldy cheese! Report back to Kevin.
Kevin wants you to tell Hugo that they order those uniforms.
Hugo has agreed to make the uniforms, report back to Kevin!
You have reported back that you have completed the mission.

states.1: Kevin wants you to bring him the measurements of Benjamin, Lokur, Dove, Liane, Chrystal and Olrik.
states.2: You have received the measurements from 1 of 6 post officers.
states.3: You have received the measurements from 2 of 6 post officers.
states.4: You have received the measurements from 3 of 6 post officers.
states.5: You have received the measurements from 4 of 6 post officers.
states.6: You have received the measurements from 5 of 6 post officers.
states.8: You have received all measurements, report back to Kevin!
states.9: You have reported back that you have completed the mission.

missions.name: Mission 08 - Missing Courier
states: Kevin wants you to find the missing courier Waldo or at least his posthorn.
You have found Waldos posthorn.
You have reported back that you have completed the mission.

missions.name: Mission 09 - Dear Santa
states: Kevin wants you to deliver som letters to Santa Claus on Vega.
You have retrieved the letters, deliver them to Santa Claus on Vega.
You have delivered the letters to Santa Claus on Vega.
You have reported back that you have completed the mission.

missions.name: Mission 10 - Mintwallin
states: Kevin wants you to deliver a letter  to Markwin, king of Mintwallin from his mother.
You have delivered the letter to Markwin.
You have reported back that you have completed the mission.

missions.name: Postman Rank
states: Assistant Postman
Postman
Grand Postman
Grand Postman for Special Operations
Arch Postman

missions.name: A Djinn in Love
states: You need to return to Marina and ask her for a date with Ocelus.
You need to return to Ocelus with the bad news.
Ocelus told you to get a poem for him, if you didn't buy one already, head to Ab'Dendriel and buy a Love Poem from Elvith.
You need to go recite the poem to Marina and impress her with the Djinn's romantic and poetic abilities.
After reciting the poem to Marina, she decided to date Ocelus and release Ray Striker from her spell.

missions.name: A Poem for the Mermaid
states: You need to find the man-stealing mermaid and try to break her spell over poor Raymond, the mermaid Marina is near the northern coast of the island.
You discovered that she does in fact have a spell on him, and will not release him unless someone better comes along.
You are a true master in reciting love poems now. No mermaid will be able to resist if you ask for a date!

missions.name: Access to Goroma
missions.description: After helping Jack Fate to collect the 30 woodpieces, Jack Fate in Liberty Bay will bring you to Goroma.

missions.name: Access to Laguna Island
missions.description: After arranging a date for Marina and Ocelus, you are allowed to use Marina's sea turtles. They will bring you to the idyllic Laguna Islands.

missions.name: Access to Meriana
missions.description: After earning the trust of the governor's daughter Eleonore, Captain Waverider in Liberty Bay will bring you to Meriana if you tell him the secret codeword 'peg leg'.

missions.name: Access to Nargor
missions.description: After convincing the people in Sabrehaven that you are a trustworthy hero, Sebastian will sail you to Nargor.

missions.name: Ray's Mission 1: Fafnar's Fire
states: Ray Striker asked you to travel to Edron and pretend to the alchemist Sandra that you are the one whom the other pirates sent to get the fire. When she asks for a payment, tell her 'Your continued existence is payment enough'.
Sandra will be enraged and will cut any deals with pirates. Report back to Raymond Striker.
Ray Striker was pleased to hear about Sandra's rage. If you haven't done so yet, ask him for other missions.

missions.name: Ray's Mission 2: Sabotage
states: Buy a fire bug at Liberty Bay and infiltrate Nargor. Find the pirates' harbor and use the fire bug to sabotage their catapult there.
You were able to sabotage the catapult in the pirate's harbor. Report back to Ray Striker to tell him about mission.
Ray Striker was pleased to hear about successful sabotage. If you haven't done so yet, ask him for other missions.

missions.name: Ray's Mission 3: Spy Mission
states: Travel to Nargor and try to enter de pirate's tavern by deceiving the guard in front of it. Read all the plans which you can find in the tavern and report back to Striker.
You studied all of the pirate's plans in their tavern which will give insight about their next strikes. If you haven't done so yet, ask Ray for another mission.

missions.name: Ray's Mission 4: Proof of Death
states: Travel to Nargor and try to find out more about the mission Klaus offers. He apparently wants the death of Ray Striker and your task is to convince him that Ray is dead.
Klaus told you to kill Ray Striker and bring him his lucky pillow as a proof. Ray should be interested in hearing about this mission.
You informed Ray that Klaus needs his lucky pillow as proof of his death. Ray gave it to you, now go convince Klaus that the mission is fulfilled and Ray is Dead!
Klaus belieaves that Ray Striker is dead and will celebrate a big party. You should tell Ray about your successful mission.
Ray was very impressed to hear about your successful mission and gave you a ship and a pirate outfit as reward.

states.2: Ariella asked you for a few days of adequate supply. Help her and improve your reputation in Sabrehaven.
states.3: You have finished one mission. Ask Arelia again for another mission This will improve your reputation in Sabrehaven.
states.4: Ariella asked you to bring a sample of whisper beer from a secret whisper bar in Carlin. Help her and improve your reputation in Sabrehaven.
states.5: You have finished two missions. Ask Morgan in Sabrehaven for another mission This will improve your reputation in Sabrehaven.
states.6: Morgan asked you to deliver a letter safely to old Eremo on Cormaya. Help him and improve your reputation in Sabrehaven.
states.7: You delivered the letter safely to old Eremo. Report back to Morgan and improve your reputation in Sabrehaven.
states.8: You have finished three missions. Ask Duncan in Sabrehaven for another mission This will improve your reputation and earn his trust.
states.9: Duncan requested an atlas of the explorers society. Help him and improve your reputation in Sabrehaven.
states.10: You have finished four missions. Ask Chondur in Sabrehaven for another mission This will improve your reputation in Sabrehaven.
states.11: Chondur asked at least five pirate voodoo dolls to lift the curse. Help him and improve your reputation in Sabrehaven.
states.12: You have finished five missions. You are now a friend of Sabrehaven.
You have finished five missions. People in Sabrehaven seem to start trusting you. Maybe this is a good time for some more difficult missions.
states.13: You have finished six missions. People in Sabrehaven seem to start trusting you. Maybe this is a good time for some more difficult missions.
states.14: You have finished seven missions. People in Sabrehaven seem to start trusting you. Maybe this is a good time for some more difficult missions.

missions.name: Reputation in Sabrehaven: Cordial
missions.description: You have finished eight missions. People in Sabrehaven seem to trust you, but there is still one last mission left.

states.16: You have finished nine missions. People in Sabrehaven are considering you as one of them.
states.17: You have finished all missions. People in Sabrehaven are considering you as one of them and you earned their full trust.

missions.name: The Counterspell
states: You have begun Chondur's ritual. Bring him a fresh dead chicken so that he can begin to create a counterspell which will allow you to pass the magical barrier on Goroma.
You have begun Chondur's ritual. Bring him a fresh dead rat so that he can continue creating a counterspell which will allow you to pass the magical barrier on Goroma.
You have begun Chondur's ritual. Bring him a fresh dead black sheep so that he can complete his counterspell which will allow you to pass the magical barrier on Goroma.
You may pass the energy barrier on Goroma. The counterspell Chondur created for you with his ritual will allow you to withstand the evil magic of the cultist.

missions.name: The Errand
states: You told Eleonore to run a small errand. Deliver the 200 gold pieces she gave to the herbalist Charlotta in the south-western part of Liberty Bay.
You delivered the gold to Charlotta. Return to Eleonore and tell her the secret password: peg leg

missions.name: The Governor's Daughter
states: You promised to find Eleonore's lost ring. She told you that a parrot stole it from her dressing table and flew to the nearby mountains. You might need a rake to retrieve the ring.
You found the ring. Return it to Eleonore.
You returned the ring to Eleonore.

missions.name: Mission 1: Ivory Poaching
states: Dorian wants you to collect 10 elephant tusks and deliver them to him.
You delivered the ten tusks to Dorian.

missions.name: Mission 2: Burglary
states: Dorian wants you to steal a vase from Sarina, the owner of Carlin's general store.
You have stolen the vase, report back to Dorian!
You have delivered the stolen vase to Dorian, ask him for a new mission!

missions.name: Mission 3: Invitation
states: Your task is to somehow convince Oswald to hand you an invitation to the king's ball.
You have received the invitation to the King's ball, report back to Dorian!
You have delivered the invitation to Dorian, ask him for a new mission!

missions.name: Mission 4: Bridge Robbery
states: Dorian wants you to find a forger in the outlaw camp, go talk to Snake eye.
Snake Eye told you to visit Ahmet in Ankrahmun.
Ahmet told you that he will only help a friend and asked you to kill at least one Nomad.
You have killed a Nomad, go back to Ahmet!
You have received the forged documents from Ahmet, next is to get a disguise from Percybald in Carlin!
You have received the dwarf disguise from Percybald. Now go do the deal with Nurik.
You have traded the forged documents for the painting, report back to Dorian.
You have delivered the painting to Dorian, ask him for a new mission!

missions.name: Mission 5: Enforcing Debts
states: Your mission is to travel to Tiquanda. Fina a hidden smuggler cave to the north of Port Hope and try to retrieve the valuable goblet which Dorian is looking for. Once you got it, bring it to him.
You have delivered the golden goblet to Dorian, ask him for a new mission!

missions.name: Mission 6: Fishnapping
states: Dorian wants you to fishnap Theodore Loveless' fish, first you need to get the key to his room. Talk to Chantalle in Liberty Bay.
You have received the key for Theodore Loveless' room, time to fishnap his fish!
You have fishnapped Theodore Loveless' fish, deliver it to Dorian.
You have delivered the fish to Dorian, ask him for a new mission!

missions.name: Mission 7: Blackmail
states: Your current task is to find compromising information about one of the Venore city guards, no matter how. A good starting point might be in their barracks.
You have delivered the compromising letter to Dorian, ask him for a new mission!

missions.name: Mission 8: Message
states: Dorian wants you to deliver a message to his competitors in the dark cathedral.
You have put up the message, report back to Dorian.
You have reported back that you have completed the mission, Dorian now allows you to trade with Black Bert.

missions.name: Mission 1: Trophy
states: Your first mission for becoming a recognized trader is to bring the traveling salesman Rashid a Deer Trophy.
You have completed this mission. Talk with Rashid to continue.

missions.name: Mission 2: Delivery
states: Your mission is to get the package from Willard the weapon dealer at Edron.
Willard forgot to pick it up from Snake Eye at Outlaw Camp. So he wants you to go and pick it up from Snake Eye.
Take the package just next door.
Now bring back the package to Rashid.
You have completed this mission. Talk with Rashid to continue.

missions.name: Mission 3: Cheese
states: Rashid wants you to pick his special order from Miraia in Darashia. But you have to be quick, Scarab cheese can rot really fast in high temperature.
Now quickly bring back the Scarab cheese to Rashid.
You have completed this mission. Talk with Rashid to continue.

missions.name: Mission 4: Vase
states: Rashid have ordered a special elven vase from Briasol in Ab'Dendriel. He asks you to buy it from Briasol and bring it back. But you should be carefully, since the vase is very fragile.
Now carefully bring the vase back to Rashid.
You have completed this mission. Talk with Rashid to continue.

missions.name: Mission 5: Make a deal
states: This time, Rashid is testing your trading skills to buy a Crimson Sword from Uzgod. But it have to be less than 400 gold coins and the quality has to be perfect.
Now bring the sword back to Rashid.
You have completed this mission. Talk with Rashid to continue.

missions.name: Mission 6: Goldfish
states: Rashid wants you to bring him a Goldfish Bowl.
You have completed this mission. Talk with Rashid to continue.

missions.name: Mission 7: Declare
states: Rashid has declare you as one of his recognized traders, and now you are able to trade with him anytime..

missions.name: Joining the Explorers
states: The mission should be simple to fulfil. You have to seek out Uzgod in Kazordoon and get the pickaxe for us. Or just find dwarven pickaxe on your own...
Get into Dwacatra and get Uzgod's family brooch.
Bring family brooch back to Uzgod
Bring the pickaxe back to the Explorer Society representative.
You have completed Joining the Explorers

states.6: Take this ice pick and use it on a block of ice in the caves beneath Folda. Get some ice and bring it here as fast as you can. If the ice melt away, report on your ice delivery mission anyway.
states.7: You have 10 minutes before the icicle defrosts. Run back to the Explorer Society representative!
states.8: You have completed The Ice Delivery.

states.9: This preparation kit will allow you to collect a PURPLE butterfly you have killed. Just use it on the fresh corpse of a PURPLE butterfly.
states.10: Return the prepared butterfly to Explorer Society representative.
states.12: This preparation kit will allow you to collect a BLUE butterfly you have killed. Just use it on the fresh corpse of a BLUE butterfly.
states.13: Return the prepared butterfly to Explorer Society representative.
states.15: This preparation kit will allow you to collect a RED butterfly you have killed. Just use it on the fresh corpse of a RED butterfly.
states.16: Return the prepared butterfly to Explorer Society representative.
states.17: You have completed The Butterfly Hunt.

states.18: Take botanist's container. Use it on a jungle bells plant to collect a sample.
states.19: Report about your plant collection to Explorer Society representative.
states.20: Ask for plant collection when you are ready to continue.
states.21: Use botanist's container on a witches cauldron to collect a sample.
states.22: Report about your plant collection to Explorer Society representative.
states.23: Ask for plant collection when you are ready to continue.
states.24: Use this botanist's container on a giant jungle rose to obtain a sample.
states.25: Report about your plant collection to Explorer Society representative.
states.26: You have completed The Plant Collection.

states.27: In the south-east of Tiquanda is a small settlement of the lizard people. Beneath the newly constructed temple there, the lizards hide the urn. Acquire an ancient urn which is some sort of relic to the lizard people of Tiquanda.
states.28: Bring the Funeral Urn back to the Explorer Society.
states.29: You have completed The Lizard Urn.

states.30: Travel to the city of Darashia and then head north-east for the pyramid. If any documents are left, you probably find them in the catacombs beneath.
states.31: Bring the Wrinkled Parchment back to the Explorer Society representative.
states.32: You have completed The Bonelord Secret.

states.33: As far as we can tell, the orcs maintain some sort of training facility in some hill in the north-east of their city. There you should find lots of their war wolves and hopefully also some of the orcish powder.
states.34: Bring the Strange Powder to the Explorer Society representative to complete your mission.
states.35: You have completed The Orc Powder.

states.36: This mission is easy but nonetheless vital. Travel Hellgate beneath Ab'Dendriel and get the book.
states.37: Bring back an elven poetry book to the Explorer Society representative.
states.38: You have completed The Elven Poetry.

states.39: In the ruins of north-western Edron you should be able to find a memory stone.
states.40: Bring back a memory stone to the Explorer Society representative.
states.41: You have completed The Memory Stone.

states.42: Somewhere under the ape infested city of Banuta, one can find dungeons that were once inhabited by lizards. Look there for an atypical structure that would rather fit to Ankrahmun and its Ankrahmun Tombs. Copy the runes you will find on this structure.
states.43: Report back to the Explorer Society representative.
states.44: You have completed The Rune Writings.

states.45: Take ectoplasm container and use it on a ghost that was recently slain.
states.46: Return back to the Explorer Society representative with the collected ectoplasm.

states.48: The queen of the banshees lives in the so called Ghostlands, south west of Carlin. Try to get a spectral dress from her.
states.49: Report to the Explorer Society with the spectral dress.

states.51: Please travel to our second base and ask them to mail us their latest research reports. Then return here and ask about new missions.
states.52: Tell our fellow explorer that the papers are in the mail already.
states.53: Take the spectral essence and use it on the strange carving in this building as well as on the corresponding tile in our second base.
states.54: Good! Now use the spectral essence on the strange carving in our second base.

states.56: Both carvings are now charged and harmonised. You are able to travel in zero time from one base to the other, but you need to have an orichalcum pearl in your possession to use it as power source.

states.57: Travel to Okolnir and try to find a proof for the existence of dragon lords there in the old times. I think old Buddel might be able to bring you there.
states.58: Report back to Lurik with the dragon scale.

states.60: There is a cave on Hrodmir, north of the southernmost barbarian camp Krimhorn. In this cave, there are a waterfall and a lot of stalagmites. Take the resonance crystal and use it on the stalagmites in the cave to record the sound of the wind.
states.62: Now you may use the Astral Bridge from Liberty Bay to Svargrond.

missions.name: The Undersea Kingdom
states: Captain Max will bring you to Calassa whenever you are ready. Please try to retrieve the missing logbook which must be in one of the sunken shipwrecks.
Report about your Calassa mission to Berenice in Liberty Bay.
Congratulations, you completed the remaining part of this mission!

states: Investigate the catacombs. Abbot Costello should be interested in information about brother Fugio.
You returned Fugio's Diary. Costello was very thankful about your help and gave you a blessed ankh as reward.

missions.name: Access to the Isle of Kings
To Appease the Mighty

Umar said he won't be part of Kazzan's plans. Now you need to try with Ubaid.
Umar and Ubaid said they won't be part of those plans. Return to Kazzan and collect your reward.
You have completed the quest!

missions.name: Arito's Task
states: Arito asked you to make a peace agreement between him and the Nomads.
Return to Arito and tell him the good news.
Now Arito are safe and you have access to Nomads Cave.

missions.name: Against the Spider Cult
states: Daniel Steelsoul in Edron wants you to infiltrate the Edron Orc Cave and destroy 4 Spider Eggs.
You destroyed 1 of 4 Spider Eggs in the Edron Orc Cave
You destroyed 2 of 4 Spider Eggs in the Edron Orc Cave
You destroyed 3 of 4 Spider Eggs in the Edron Orc Cave
You destroyed all Spider Eggs in the Edron Orc Cave, report back to Daniel Steelsoul!
You have completed the Quest!

missions.name: An Interest In Botany
states: Rabaz in Farmine asked you to collect samples from rare plant specimen in Zao. Go to the storage room to the west and receive the Botany Almanach. Find then the Giant Dreadcoil and use your Obsidian Knife on it to obtain a sample.
Now you must find the second plant, a Giant Verminous and use your Obsidian Knife on it to obtain a sample.
You found the two samples, report back to Rabaz in Farmine!
You have completed the Quest!

strings: You sanctified %d of 15 graves.

missions.name: Into the Bone Pit
states: Search the Cursed Bone Pit in the dungeon north of Thais and dig for a well-preserved human bone for Muriel.
You have found a desecrated bone for Muriel.
You helped Muriel to obtain a desecrated bone.

missions.name: Rest in Hallowed Ground
states: Go to the white raven monastery and ask for some holy water for Amanda.
You got the holy water from the white raven monastery. Go back to Amanda and report about your mission.
Sanctify every single grave at the unholy graveyard north of Edron with the holy water.
You have sanctified all graves at the unholy graveyard of Edron. Report about your mission at Amanda.
You helped Amanda by sanctifying the cursed graveyard of Edron.

missions.name: The Exterminator
states: Padreia in Carlin asked you to exterminate the slimes in the sewers of Carlin by poisoning their spawn pool.
You poisoned the spawn pool of the slimes in the sewers of Carlin. Report to Padreia about your mission.
You successfully helped Padreia in saving Carlin from a slimy disease.

missions.name: The Ultimate Booze
states: Boozer in Vernore asked you to bring him some special dwarven brown ale. You may find some in the brewery in Kazordoon.
You found the special dwarven brown ale. Bring it to Boozer in Vernore.
You have completed The Ultimate Booze Quest!

missions.name: Jack to the Future
states: Spectulus told you about a failed experiment he once did, involving an intern named Jack, and asked you to help him rescue Jack. Go to Jack's house and talk to him about Spectulus.
You have talked to Jack and found out that he is not remembering the time accident or Spectulus. Return to Spectulus in the Edron Academy to tell him about your findings.
Spectulus wants you to trigger Jack's memory. Jack used to like his red cushioned chair, an old globe, a telescope, a large amphora and a rocking horse. Place those in his room and ask him about it.
You have talked to Jack about the furniture you placed in his house. Report it back to Spectulus in the Edron Academy.
Spectulus sent you once again to his former intern Jack. Explain the incident to the people close to him. Talk to Jack's mother and sister and return to Spectulus to report their reaction.
You have talked with Jack's mother and sister. Report it back to Spectulus.
Spectulus suggested asking Jack abouthis hobbies. Make Jack leave his hobby be by whateber means it takes. Only by doing this he will be separated from what distracts him from his former self.
You found out and destroyed Jack's hobby. Jack is now finally ready and beginning to change. He event seems to start remembering Spectulus and the Academy.
Jack is finally remembering Spectulus and the Academy. Report back your mission.
Spectulus found out that you were convincing the wrong Jack. His real intern was transported way back to the past. He left a note years ago which, to your misery, reached Spectulus a little too late.

strings: %s

states.0: A pirate told you about an evil artifact down in the crystal caves under Nargor.It is a big crystal that affects the caves in a negative manner. Perhaps a jarring,very loud sound could destroy it.
states.1: You found an old inscription to a mysterious recipe: 'vial of emb... fl... and mix ... a medusa's bl... Then ... the dust of ... crystal ... get Medusa's Ointm... able to unpetrify ...'
states.2: You mixed the proper ingredients to create a special salve. The Medusa's Ointment. With this balm you may unpetrify a petrified object.
states.3: With the Medusa's Ointment you unpetrified a banshee's scream near the evil crystal. Thus the baleful artefact was destroyed. You should return to One-Eyed Joe.
states.4: You have completed the Quest!

missions.name: Hidden Threats
states: You have talked to Corym Ratter. He asked you to find the reason why the amount of  delivered ores is decreasing. You got access to the mine.
You have met Corym Servant. He told you the true story of enslaved corym working under  terrible conditions. You have agreed to help him planing a riot. First you have to liberate his comrades.
You have found two key fragments. They are quite rusted. It is necessary to remove the  rust before forging them together. You have to find a way to rebuild the key. This might open the doors.
With the forged key you have unlocked the three areas. The Corym Servant was very relieved  and asked you to bring 20 units of rare earth.
You have brought 20 units of rare earth to Corym Servant. He was very thankful and gave you  a reward. The revolution should now take place as intended.

missions.name: To Outfox a Fox
states: Budrik asked you to look for the hideout of the Horned Fox and bring his stolen mining helmet back. The Fox's lair is presumed to be west of Kazordoon near the coast.
You succesfully helped Budrik in stealing back his old mining helemt.

missions.name: Fish for a Serpent
states: Your first task is to bring 5 fish.
Your second task is to bring 5 northern pike.
Your third task is to bring 5 green perch.
Your forth task is to bring 5 rainbow trout.
You bring enough fish to make the bait. Now you're ready for the hunt.

missions.name: The hunt for the Sea Serpent
states: You navigated the ship to the right location. You are now able to dive down and explore the caves.

missions.name: The hunt for the Sea Serpent

states: Your mission is to find the Holy Skull. It is in a cave in the northern orc settlement, which is located north-west on the Zao Steppe.
You found the Holy Skull. Retrieve it to Lazaran in the Zao Mountains.
You brought Lazaran the Holy Skull. Ask him for new mission!

missions.name: Mission 2: All Around the World
states: You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. You need to stand at the highest place of Edron.
You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. You need to stand at the highest place of Ab'dendriel.

You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. You need to stand at the highest place of Carlin
You visited all the highest places with the skull. Turn the skull back to Lazaran and report him your mission!
You turned the skull already back to Lazaran. Ask him for new mission!

missions.name: Mission 3: Dance Dance Evolution
states: Lazaran told you to go to Ulala, who is located above Lazaran.
Ulala told you to dance to please their god Krunus. On the south mountain in the camp you will find the Krunus altar, there are lots of leaves on the ground.
You solved the dance. Head back to Ulala and report your mission!

missions.name: Mission 4: Bits and Pieces
states: Now the god Krunus is pleased, another god called Pandor needs to be pleased. Ulala wants you to collect 5 Orc Teeth, 5 Minotaur leathers and 5 Lizard Leathers. Bring them to her.
You brought Ulala 5 Orc Teeth, 5 Minotaur leathers and 5 Lizard Leathers. Ask her for new mission!

missions.name: Mission 5: Ray of Light
states: The third god which needs to be pleased is called Fasuon. Find the great crystal on top of mountain of Fasuon and pray there for his support!
You already prayed at the great crystal. Report it to Ulala
You have reported back to Ulala that you have completed the mission.

missions.name: Mission 6: Firewater Burn
states: Speak with Lazaran and tell the gods are pleased now.
Bring Lazaran a Pot of brown water for a party after the great hunt.
You brought Lazaran the beer and got a Serpent Crest as reward!

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - Tasks of a Fool
states: Cut a flower at the Whiteflower Temple south of Thais. Then report to Bozo about your mission.
You have finished your first mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - That stinks!
states: It sometimes stinks to be a fool. Collect some noxious fumes from a recently slain slime with the special vial. Then report to Bozo about your mission.
You have finished your second mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - A Piece of Cake
states: Get 12 pies from Mirabell in Edron. Then report to Bozo about your mission.
You have finished your third mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - Fool Spirits
states: Get 18 vials of wine for Bozo. Then report to Bozo about your mission.
Exchange the crates in front of Xodet's house and return to Bozo with the swapped crate.
You have finished your fourth mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - Watch out for the foolish
states: Steal the magic watch from the Triangle Tower west of Jakundaf Desert. Then report to Bozo about your mission.
Use the magic watch to steal the beard of the sleeping dwarven emperor.
You have already finished five missions for that fool. You should definitely talk to Bozo about your jester outfit now!

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - The queen of farts
states: Get Bozo 4 pieces of minotaur leather.
Get Bozo a piece of giant spider silk.
Ask Bozo about your mission, he might be finished with the whoopee cushion by now.
Place the whoopee cushion on the queen's throne in Carlin by using the cushion with the throne.
You have finished your sixth mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - For your mice only
states: Get the toy mouse of Queen Eloise's cat and show it to Carina, the jeweler in Venore, to scare her.
You have finished your seventh mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - Smoking is a foolish thing
states: Gather some easily inflammable sulphur using a spoon on an inactive lava hole.
You brought Bozo the sulphur. Now cut him some leaves of the jungle dweller bush with a kitchen knife.
You have gathered the ordered ingredients and should ask Bozo for the next mission.
Deliver the exploding cigar to Theodore Loveless in Liberty Bay.
You have finished your eighth mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - A fool's bargain
states: Bozo wants you to fill a vial with the blood of a stalker. Use the vial on a slain stalker immediately after his death. Then report to Bozo about your mission.
Bozo wants you to fill a vial with the ink of a quara constrictor. Use the vial on a slain constrictor immediately after its death. Then report to Bozo about your mission.
You have gathered the ordered ingredients and should ask Bozo for the next mission.
Order 2000 steel shields from Sam. Sign his contract with the magic ink.
You have finished your ninth mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - A sweet surprise
states: Deliver a cookie to Avar Tar, Simon, Ariella, Lorbas, King Markwin, Hjaern, Wyda, Hairycles, the orc king and EITHER Yaman OR Nah'Bob. Then report to Bozo about the mission.
You have finished your tenth mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - The final foolishness
states: Gather 5 pieces of white cloth for Bozo. Then report about your mission.
Travel to Darama and climb the highest point of the Plague Spike to give these pieces of white cloth an old and worn look. Some ancient altar should suit your needs best - use the white cloth on it.
Use your mummy disguise to scare the caliph Kazzan in Darashia. DON'T use the disguise too early or you will fail the quest.
You have finished all of Bozo's missions and you are a complete fool now. Yay!

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - To become a complete fool

states.4: Now that you have a basic outfit, you should talk to Bozo about your missions to gain further rewards.
